create.name: Liza Colpa
create.bio:
Liza Colpa is a yoga and meditation teacher from New York who weaves tarot, astrology and seasonal ritual into her classes. She came to yoga as a teenager through a class at a local spa, practised for a decade before training as a teacher, and now holds a 500-hour qualification with well over a thousand hours of teaching behind her. Over the years her mat practice opened onto meditation and then onto older ways of reflection, among them the tarot, the zodiac, herbal lore and folk ritual, which she gathers under the name witchy wellness.

Her teaching is practical and gentle, built on the idea that each of these tools can bring a person back to their own inner knowing. On Insight Timer she has published courses on manifestation, the chakras, shadow work and the Major Arcana, alongside short meditations for rest and clarity. Her YouTube channel carries free yoga flows tied to the moon and the turning of the year, simple talks on how manifestation works, and astrology forecasts. Based in Queens, she offers private meditation and tarot sessions online and has run small one-day retreats in Brooklyn that combine movement, ritual and time in a circle.

courses.title: Astro Yoga Flow for Achieving Your Goals
courses.description: A self-paced course on her own site in twelve modules, one for each sign of the zodiac, pairing a yoga flow with the qualities of that sign and journal questions for working towards a goal. It runs to more than five hours with a printable workbook and lifetime access.

courses.title: Private Meditation and Tarot Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one sessions booked online: a thirty-minute private meditation, or a longer session that pairs a tarot reading with meditation. Add-ons include a chakra balancing meditation and a personal monthly astrology calendar.

courses.title: Everyday Arcana
courses.description: A daily Insight Timer course that walks through the twenty-two cards of the Major Arcana, using each card as a starting point for meditation, affirmation and journaling rather than fortune-telling.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: Manifesting Abundant Living With The Chakras
courses.description: A nine-day Insight Timer course of short talks, meditations and optional journaling that moves up through the seven chakras, looking at the history behind them and at old stories about scarcity held in each.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

free_resources.title: Liza Colpa on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations, yoga sessions and talks on manifestation, the chakras and the moon's cycles, along with several multi-day courses. The single tracks are free to hear.
